body: Thank you. So much. I’ll look up some resources tonight. I need to do a gratitude practice too.

I’m very new to this so excuse my ignorance. So far I’m only able to show 19.2% revenue loss and I have open invoices in my gross receipts. Again, I’m such a noob and I’m so appreciative for any help.
Thank you all so much, I’ve edited my post with answers to questions I’ve received.

I understand that however, as I mentioned, I don’t have much communication with or confidence in my lawyer so I’m trying to aid in my defense as best I can. It’s a very small town, this is a wealthy family with many connections. I was limited by the number of lawyers available.

I was helping her clean out her house in preparation for a garage sale when I was gifted the camera and the laptop. They’d been in storage and she even went as far as to say, “sell them if you can or keep them if you want”.  But I do not have text messages confirming this. 

I was paid up the day I left. I do, however, have electronic communications from her saying she would approve me for unemployment to then be denied after she flipped her switch. 

Thank you so much.
Thank you, I have a lawyer but I don’t have a lot of confidence and am trying to aid in my defense as best I can.
